fdr_firm_level_headline.label: HEADLINE — episodic exceedance, dependence-calibrated
fdr_firm_level_headline.scope: validated end-to-end at the primary q<=0.01 level: under a global-null simulation with calibration frozen from the real clean data, 0/1312 clean firms are falsely discovered at q<=0.01. q<=0.05 is secondary and carries a small quantified excess (~2/1312 clean firms).

secondary.caveat: controlled up to the calibration rho (~0.30); q<=0.05 is the fragile one -- the end-to-end clean-firm diagnostic shows ~2/1312 false discoveries here (~0.5% of the reported count), vs 0/1312 at q<=0.01.

min_pvalue.label: diagnostic — min-p over quarters (anti-conservative, not valid)

harmonic.label: valid, persistence (Vovk-Wang harmonic, conservative e*ln K)

harmonic_sharp.label: valid, persistence (Vovk-Wang harmonic, sharp finite a_{-1,K})

cauchy.label: sensitivity / heavy-tail (not a headline guarantee without local calibration)

_contamination_baselines_note.change: p-value-merger baseline comparison: per contamination mechanism, best covariance-aware composite lens vs best agnostic p-value merger (Bonferroni/Simes/Hommel/Vovk-Wang arithmetic + harmonic in both conservative and sharp finite-factor forms), mean AUC over the contamination-rate grid. The composite family records the best AUC on all 8 completed mechanisms; substantive gains (best AUC>=0.65) on threshold clustering, digit distortion and cross-statement inconsistency; cost-of-debt and seasonal mechanisms stay near chance. abn_disx_full omitted (no completed contamination cases).

typeI_end_to_end.scope: full scoring-pipeline type-I conditional on the empirical clean-firm detector/null distribution; calibration frozen from real C; NOT a raw Compustat data-generating process
typeI_end_to_end._note: End-to-end type-I of the full scoring pipeline under a global null, calibration frozen from the real clean data. Row-level Holm RED controlled (0.0085<0.01). Firm-level primary claim validated end-to-end at q<=0.01 (0/1312 clean firms); secondary q<=0.05 carries a small quantified excess (2/1312, ~0.5% of 421). Parametric AR(1) sweep stable through rho_true=0.40; the residual is empirical tail structure in a few clean-firm trajectories, not a calibration collapse. rho_cal kept at 0.30 (no post-hoc recalibration).

ratio_compliance_sensitivity.scope: scoped sensitivity: retaining the ratio-cap-violating authority rows in C (require_ratio_compliance=False); reported BESIDE the canonical run, never a replacement of the canonical pipeline or the 324-firm headline
ratio_compliance_sensitivity.decomposition_rule: max relative exceedance r=max_j (ratio_j-cap_j)/cap_j; r>0.25 = large source discrepancy / likely filing-data mismatch; r<=0.25 = candidate statistical anomaly; pre-registered, robustness at 0.10 and 0.50
ratio_compliance_sensitivity._note: Scoped ratio-cap exclusion sensitivity. Retaining the ~13% ratio-violating rows (require_ratio_compliance=False) widens the null in this run -> a more conservative count (284/360 vs the canonical 324/421), so the exclusion sharpens power rather than manufacturing discoveries. 90% of retained rows stay GREEN; the 62 that flag RED are dominated by large source discrepancies / likely filing-data mismatches (47 at the pre-registered 25% cut), with a small residual of candidate statistical anomalies among borderline exceedances (15). Reported beside the canonical run; the 324-firm headline is unchanged.

cluster_bootstrap_robustness.scope: Firm-cluster vs i.i.d.-row resample of the row-level bootstrap null, reported alongside the canonical run; the exceedance calibration (rho_cal) and the headline are NOT changed.
cluster_bootstrap_robustness._note: Firm-cluster bootstrap robustness of the row-level null. Whole clean firms drawn with replacement (only the last cluster truncated to match B) vs the canonical i.i.d.-row resample. Central critical values and firm discovery counts statistically unchanged (firm q<=0.01 mean 319 row vs 321 cluster; canonical fixed-seed 324/421 inside both bands); MC dispersion ~1.6x wider, as expected when within-firm dependence is preserved. rho_cal=0.30 and the exceedance cache held fixed; only the row-level null varies; production default resampler untouched. Not an invalidation of the exceedance headline (the end-to-end type-I analysis carries the error control). Source: cluster_bootstrap_robustness.py + outputs/scores/mys/cluster_bootstrap/.

config.boundary_rule: 70/30 by clean-year count (16 train / 7 test years), fixed ex ante

per_detector_ks_normal_is_vs_oos._note_parametric: z2, z6 are parametric detectors (not empirically PIT-normal by construction) and are not part of the drift claim.

calibration_holdout_split.scope: Chronological calibration/test split (MYS anchor): PIT + Sigma-hat + bootstrap null calibrated on the training-year clean rows only, evaluated on the held-out later-year clean rows. Reported alongside the canonical run; the headline and full-C calibration are NOT changed.
calibration_holdout_split._note: Chronological calibration/test split. Row-level calibration (empirical PIT, Ledoit-Wolf Sigma-hat, bootstrap null) trained on the training-year clean rows (2003-2018) via the _split hook (canonical pipeline untouched), evaluated on the held-out later-year clean rows (2019-2025). Decision-level calibration transfers: OOS RED 0.64% ~ IS 0.72% (held-out clean rows near the nominal rate). Detector-level PIT diagnostics show mild OOS drift (empirically PIT'd detectors move from KS~0 in-sample to 0.03-0.05 OOS), read as decision-rule stability, not time-invariant detector validity, consistent with the temporal-drift analysis. Boundary 2019 fixed ex ante (70/30 by year). Source: calibration_holdout_split.py + outputs/scores/mys/calibration_holdout/.

_firm_headline_note.scope: Validated end-to-end at the primary q<=0.01 level; q<=0.05 is secondary and carries a small quantified excess. Reproducing these numbers requires the licensed Compustat panels under data/ (see README); the figures were verified against those panels.
